prompt_replacements.old:
Each requested_value_meaning is another value the answer must state. Write its
expression in requested_value_outputs. A requested value may itself be an
entity identity. Preserve the shown order within each output list.
prompt_replacements.new:
Each requested_value_meaning is another value the answer must state. Write its
expression in requested_value_outputs. Decide whether it is an observed value
or an entity identity. An entity identity distinct from the candidate and from
any supplied identity role uses its own declared related set and association,
then a related_instance identifier fact. Preserve the shown order within each
output list.
